programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Boat Rescue Mission
programs.desc: While collecting coal on the beach after a storm, Eivin and Eve find a capsized boat and begin looking for survivors  Otto, Charlotte and August build a shelter for their calves  Jane brings the family together with a new spring tradition.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold: Shift Happens
programs.desc: As the miners look to find more valuable ground, Shawn must fight the sea's shifting tide  Ken strains his excavator arm when digging hard cobble  Kris tries his chances with a rookie diver  new diver Brian saves Vernon's day.
